en: I've a Horsea here, but what I've always wanted is a Bagon. Would you trade me one?
A Bagon, at last! Seasor's not quite like other Horsea, you'll find. Look after it!
That's no Bagon. I'll only take a real Bagon, I'm afraid.
Not today? I'm in no hurry. Bagon will come along some day.
My Bagon wants to fly. I tell it to wait until it grows wings!
